item.title: Finding Paddy — Wed Sep 9, 7:00 PM — The Clairidge
item.description:
Montclair filmmaker Steve McCarthy looks at the life of his friend FDNY Captain Patrick “Paddy” Brown, after he dies in the World Trade Center on 9/11. He finds a complicated story of a man traumatized by alcohol, the Vietnam War and the fires of New York. Sometimes a hero can come from some of the most awful places imaginable. Q&A with director Steve McCarthy and producers Nancy Erika Smith and Neil Marc Mullin follows the screening. Share this: Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook

item.title: Montclair State University Campus History Tour — Fri Sep 18, 4:00 PM — Montclair State University
item.description:
Learn about the early history of Montclair State University on a 45-minute walking tour of the south end of campus. The tour will include historic photographs of the oldest campus buildings and examples of memorabilia. We will discuss student life and interactions with the surrounding Montclair community. Archivist, Paul Martinez, will lead the tour. We will meet in front of the Kasser Theater at 4 pm. Weather permitting – the tour will be rescheduled in the event of rain. The tour is approximately half a mile long. Most of the route is accessible. There is an approximately 260-foot section which is partially-accessible due to a steep grade.' Register Here: https://montclair.libcal.com/event/17593469
Hosted by: Sprague Library
Additional Information can be found at: https://montclair.campuslabs.com/engage/event/12706559
Source: Montclair State University

item.title: In-Person and Live Stream Service — Sun Sep 20, 10:00 AM — Sanctuary
item.description:
Sunday worship takes place at 10am in person at 176 Cooper Avenue in Montclair or livestreamed on our YouTube channel: Sunday Worship Livestream Union Congregational Church is located in Montclair, New Jersey, at 176 Cooper Avenue (nearest major cross streets are Grove Street and Valley Road). There is street parking on Cooper Avenue. We have a small parking lot for seniors and those with limited mobility reached through a driveway to the left of the church. There are two accessible spots and a ramp on the left side of the building. Additional parking is available on neighboring streets. Please note that Cooper Avenue runs one way on Sundays, so it is best to enter from Valley Road or Northview Avenue. Enter the church through the main Sanctuary doors under the tower or through the accessible entrance through the Assembly Room at the top of the ramp on the left side of the church. Join Us Here Click here for the Sunday Worship Bulletin
Source: Union Congregational Church
